latin_review: Reviewed fragments are project names, loader names or publisher names, not inherited English sentences.
status_policy: Purposes are status-neutral. Baseline means the primary installed inventory, heavy and deferred remain separately recorded only in evidence. No purpose says that an installed provider is absent.
verification_scope: Inventory completeness, bilingual wording and documented provider purpose only. No game, launcher or runtime compatibility tests were performed.
review_findings: Catalog descriptions cover 290 entries, not the complete 320-entry manifest.
Explicit not-installed suffixes in older authored tables blocked otherwise exact provider-name matches. Suffix removal is used only for identity matching, never copied into final purposes.
Explorer and Nature compass tables contained search targets rather than complete purpose sentences. Both are replaced with locating functions.
Supplementaries had inherited an encounter-specific table row. Its final purpose describes the broader utility and decoration mod.
Create Dragons Plus is not described as a library alone. Its bulk processing and fluid access functions are included.
Publisher slogans are replaced with concise provider-specific functions. Expanded library summaries are based on publisher bodies rather than guessed categories.
